# Lionel Fairlie

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v5 c15 P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031)</sub>

## Appearance

Lionel Fairlie is a large, somewhat handsome figure with a tall, pale forehead and intense blue eyes that remain unaffected by age. He possesses a wide chest over which cascades a thick, long red beard, along with a thick mane of red hair untouched by grey. In his youth, he was described as a striking, red-haired colossus.

_Sources: [v5 c16 P28](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0028), [v5 c21 P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015), [v5 c22 P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001), [v5 c32 P2](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0002)_

## Personality

Lionel is loud, boisterous, direct, and self-satisfied, known for his roaring laughter and open way of courting. He can alternate between being exceptionally charming or terrifying and intimidating, often exhibiting a aggressive and bullying nature. He appreciates spirit and grit in women, disliking submissiveness, docility, and weeping. Intellectually sharp, well-read, and open-handed with his money, he can also be vocal and fierce over tiny overcharges.

_Sources: [v5 c15 P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031), [v5 c16 P28](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0028), [v5 c16 P29](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0029), [v5 c16 P55](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0055), [v5 c16 P61](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0061), [v5 c22 P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001), [v5 c26 P17](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0017), [v5 c26 P19](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0019), [v5 c26 P21](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0021), [v5 c32 P2](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0002), [v5 c34 P6](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0006), [v5 c35 P7](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0007)_

## History

In his youth, Lionel Fairlie spent two years in companionship with Harriet Ainslie before a sudden dispute led him to break off the relationship in resentment. To hurt Harriet before his anger subsided, he married Dinah Coyle, whose excessive docility and lack of resolve he held in contempt until her death. For many years, Lionel lived as a reclusive figure who rarely attended social functions or church services.

After Grace Ashdown visited his home and confronted him during an argumentative encounter, Lionel began attending church services once more. Upon seeing Harriet Ainslie at church after twenty years, he fell in love with her again and resumed courting her openly. He attended a party at the Pollocks, escorting his second cousin Amy Annetta Fairlie while engaging in a debate with Harriet. He continued visiting Harriet and Clementine Ainslie's home, persisting in his pursuit of Harriet despite her initial rejections and eventual engagement to him.

_Sources: [v5 c15 P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031), [v5 c16 P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027), [v5 c16 P55](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0055), [v5 c18 P18](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0018), [v5 c21 P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015), [v5 c22 P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001), [v5 c26 P15](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0015), [v5 c26 P17](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0017), [v5 c26 P19](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0019), [v5 c32 P16](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0016), [v5 c33 P5](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0005), [v5 c34 P6](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0006), [v5 c35 P7](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0007)_
